prompt: I'm thinking about building a tool for my team to track customer feedback. Not sure where to start.

assertions.text: Infers scope intent from the prompt (does NOT ask the cold mode question verbatim)
Offers a short confirmation like 'It sounds like you're scoping out a new project — is that right?' rather than presenting all three options
Does NOT jump to implementation questions or ask about tech stack before confirming scope intent
Does NOT invoke groundup:grill or groundup:orient before the scope path is confirmed
